reviews.title: Devs need to make items easier to get
reviews.text: I had to delete this game. It takes an ABSURD amount of energy to get the items you need. It starts out pretty normal for a merge game and I knew the level of items would get harder but this game is the worst I’ve ever played in terms of how much energy it take to get the items you need for almost every order. I’ll give some examples. Like other merge games there is a type of item (wine) that you can only get by using a generator to create a second generator. Ok. Fine. But the second generator is like a level 7 or 8 to make in the first place. That is wild!!! Also the orders that require a less common/secondary item to be generated - I once made I think a level 9 or something item before the secondary item generated. No one can play a game like this!! I also don’t like those makeup tools you have to collect. The gameplay never explains what these are so it’s super confusing. On top of that, I just didn’t enjoy the makeovers. The storylines were meh and the actual makeovers looks were not my cup of tea.
